name: inspira-sparkles-text
title: Sparkles Text
blurb: Text glows with sparkling points of light.
description: Overlays twinkling particles or shine effects on text, creating a magical shimmer. Non-interactive, runs continuously.
use_when: Premium or featured content that deserves visual polish and delight.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical labels or high-contrast requirements — sparkles reduce readability.
a11y: Pure decoration; text is readable underneath. Animation runs uncontrolled.
